name: Only the Holly
source:
The world is dying, slowly devoured by the Void. Curious after consuming too many thoughts and emotions, it sent a tendril into the world, creating Nova – who learns about life with the help of the errant noble Cass and his sister Melli, who seeks a way to stop the Void.

[From [url=https://aedifice.itch.io/only-the-holly]Itch.io[/url]]
